meta.title: Website Studio — Websites for firms that build
meta.description: Website Studio builds complete websites for architecture, interior design and construction firms — written by AI from your real projects, in English, Arabic, or both.

hero.note: 15-day free trial · No card needed · English & Arabic

orbit.copy: One short brief becomes a complete website — written by AI, built around your real projects, in English, Arabic, or both.

about.body: Tell us about your business and add what you already have: projects, services, years of experience. Website Studio writes the words, picks the sections that fit, and leaves out anything you didn't give it. No empty pages. No invented numbers.

how.label: How it works
how.intro: No page builder to learn. You answer a few questions, AI does the first draft, and you shape the rest.

brief.title: Tell us about your firm
brief.body: Name, industry and what you do. About two minutes.

facts.title: Add your projects and facts
facts.body: Projects, services, clients, awards — whatever you have. Nothing is required beyond the basics.

build.title: AI builds the website
build.body: It writes the copy, chooses the sections your content supports, and adds photos where you have none.

share.title: Arrange and share
share.body: Reorder or hide sections, edit any word or image, then share your preview link.

capabilities.label: Capabilities
capabilities.intro: One calm tool for the words, the projects, the languages and the layout — so the website reads like your firm, not like a template.

writing.title: It writes like your firm — and never invents a fact.
writing.body: AI writes every heading and paragraph from your brief. Numbers, clients, awards and names only appear if you gave them.
writing.pageTitle: Calm interiors for homes built to last.
writing.pageBody: For twelve years, Atelier Nour has designed homes and workplaces across Riyadh…
writing.insightText: — empty fields stay empty. The AI writes descriptions, not claims.

projects.title: Your work leads every page.
projects.body: Add projects with photos and they become the heart of the site. No photos yet? We place fitting ones until you upload yours.

sections.title: Arrange it your way.
sections.controls: Move up · Move down · Hide · Restore

principle.quote: “Your firm already has the story. The website should tell it in your words, around your projects.”
principle.label: Design principle

cta.label: Start today
cta.body: Answer a short brief, add your projects, and get a complete website in English, Arabic, or both.
cta.note: No card needed · One website per business · Cancel anytime

footer.tagline: The website builder for architecture, interior design and construction firms.

basics.title: Tell us about the business
basics.description: These three answers are all the AI needs to start.

offer.title: What should the site sell?

details.description: Only include facts you can stand behind. Blank fields are never invented.

placeholders.description: Describe the business, what it offers, and what makes it different.
placeholders.services: One service per line. Leave blank to let the AI infer from the description.
placeholders.awards: One per line, for example: 2023 - Swiss Architecture Prize
placeholders.notableClients: One per line. Only add names you have permission to publish.
placeholders.extraDetails: Founding story, philosophy, notable projects, or other facts to use.

review.note: AI writes the first draft of the whole website from this brief. You can edit every word afterwards.

metaPixelId.label: Meta Pixel (Facebook and Instagram)
metaPixelId.help: In Meta Events Manager, open your data source (Pixel) and copy the Pixel ID. It is 15 or 16 digits.

ga4Id.label: Google Analytics 4
ga4Id.help: In Google Analytics, go to Admin, then Data streams, open your website stream and copy the Measurement ID. It starts with G-.

tiktokPixelId.label: TikTok Pixel
tiktokPixelId.help: In TikTok Ads Manager, go to Assets, then Events, open your Web Events data source and copy the Pixel ID. It is 20 letters and numbers.

snapPixelId.label: Snapchat Pixel
snapPixelId.help: In Snapchat Events Manager, open your Pixel and copy the Pixel ID. It looks like 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc.

clarityId.label: Microsoft Clarity
clarityId.help: In Microsoft Clarity, open your project, go to Settings, then Overview, and copy the Project ID. It is 8 to 12 lowercase letters and numbers.
